title: Speaking Practice 23 - Cultural Traditions
description: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Discussion questions about cultural traditions.

stimuli.title: Part 3: Cultural Traditions Discussion
stimuli.content: In Part 3, the examiner asks abstract questions. Give extended answers with examples.

questionGroups.instruction: Discuss the following questions. Give detailed answers with examples.

questions.content: Are traditional customs still important in modern society?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, traditions provide a sense of identity and belonging. In Vietnam, customs like Tet celebrations and ancestor worship continue to strengthen family bonds across generations.

questions.content: How has globalization affected local cultures?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Globalization has introduced foreign customs and created a more homogeneous culture. For example, Western holidays like Halloween are now celebrated in Vietnam alongside traditional festivals.

questions.content: Should governments do more to preserve cultural heritage?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, through funding cultural programs, protecting historical sites, and including cultural education in school curricula. Without active preservation, many traditions may disappear.

questions.content: Do young people value traditions as much as older generations?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Generally less so, as young people are more exposed to global culture through social media. However, many still participate in important festivals and family traditions.
